The mission of the Organization is to educate children in the Catholic educational tradition by inculcating in their hearts and minds a sense of wonder and love of God's divinely inspired creation of heaven and earth and of His finest creation - humanity formed in His image and likeness. To that end, the Academy will utilize a classical pre-liberal arts curriculum in a prayerful Catholic setting to serve as the foundation for our students' lifelong quest for truth, goodness and beauty. The Organization will foster an environment rich in Catholic values and traditions to form the heart, mind and soul while instilling Christian virtue and character, graduating students that are articulate, well read and capable of applying logic and reason in their lifelong quest for divinely inspired truth.
